name: Ethena Clermont
source:
Affiliation: USF (Ship's Doctor)
Location: Okinawa, Japan
Relationship: Doctor
Personnel File: Doctor Clermont was recruited out of private practice by [url=/c136847]Admiral Halsey[/url] to assist USF counter-intelligence operations, and then remained signed on, operating her clinic and research labs with USF protection and funding.
Note Inserted in file: After she joined the Colonization mission, military intelligence gave the financial office the OK to launch an audit of Dr. Clermont's businesses.
